gloss: to listen carefully, to lend an ear

definitions.gloss: to listen carefully, to pay attention, to lend an ear
definitions.explanation: To listen with full attention and genuine interest, often implying respect for the speaker.

examples.english: I listened carefully to my senior's advice.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧ (ear) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + ⟦{傾|かたむ}ける→傾ける：11516_katamukeru⟧ (to incline, tilt). Literally 'to incline one's ear' toward something.

REGISTER: Somewhat formal/literary. Common in:
- Business contexts (listening to feedback)
- Political/civic discourse (listening to constituents)
- Advice-giving situations

NUANCE: Implies active, respectful listening rather than just hearing. Suggests openness to what is being said.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to listen) - neutral
- ⟦{傾聴|けいちょう}する→傾聴：19024_keichou⟧ (to listen attentively) - formal
- ⟦{耳|みみ}を{貸|か}す→耳を貸す：20071_mimiwokasu⟧ (to lend an ear) - similar meaning

OTHER ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧ EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{耳|みみ}が{痛|いた}い→耳が痛い：06892_mimigaitai⟧: hard to hear (criticism hits home)
- ⟦{耳|みみ}にする→耳にする：17115_miminisuru⟧: to hear about
- ⟦{耳|みみ}に{残|のこ}る→耳に残る：30620_mimininokoru⟧: to stay in one's ears (memorable)
